doc.p: Soft hyphens: an extra­ordinarily long com­pound like Donau­dampf­schiff­fahrts­gesell­schaft is broken at the hyphen that still fits, and the hyphen is shown only there.
Hard hyphens between letters: the well-known state-of-the-art north-south connection-oriented design breaks after a hyphen as in a com-pound word, also where the next letter is in another run.
A zero width space lets a long path break: /usr/​local/​share/​documentation/​examples/​configuration/​defaults without a visible space.
Spaces across runs: one space between words, however many the runs bring along.

asis: a verbatim line that is not broken even where it runs past the right edge of the area
